title: Terror in Resonance
description: In an alternate version of the present, Tokyo has been decimated by a shocking terrorist attack, and the only hint to the identity of the culprit is a bizarre video uploaded to the internet. The police, baffled by this cryptic clue, are powerless to stop the paranoia spreading across the population. While the world searches for a criminal mastermind to blame for this tragedy, two mysterious children – children who shouldn’t even exist – masterfully carry out their heinous plan. Cursed to walk through this world with the names Nine and Twelve, the two combine to form “Sphinx,” a clandestine entity determine to wake the people from their slumber – and pull the trigger on this world.

episodes_data.title: Terror in Resonance Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Lisa Mishima is having problems at school and at home when two mysterious boys transfer to her school, and she is caught up in a terrorist attack.

episodes_data.title: Terror in Resonance Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: While the police work hard to analyze Sphinx's first attack, Sphinx uploads a new video. Will they solve the new riddle in time?

episodes_data.title: Terror in Resonance Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Shibazaki joins the team working on the Sphinx Case while Sphinx tries to confirm suspicions of their own with their next riddle.

episodes_data.title: Terror in Resonance Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: In response to earlier provocation, Shibazaki is challenged with a riddle this time only he can solve in order to stop the bomb from blasting but at one condition, no one can cheat.

episodes_data.title: Terror in Resonance Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: As Lisa recuperates at Nine and Twelve's place, Sphinx sets another bomb and posts another riddle, but things don't go as planned this time.

episodes_data.title: Terror in Resonance Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Five takes over the battle of wits against Nine and Twelve as Lisa tries to find her place in their group, but Shibazaki isn't happy sitting by idly.

episodes_data.title: Terror in Resonance Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The game is on at the airport and lives are at stake as Shibazaki and his team stumble into the middle of Nine and Five's dangerous game of chess.

episodes_data.title: Terror in Resonance Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: After the incident at the airport, Nine and Twelve are forced to abandon their hideout, and Shibazaki is suspended but keeps searching for the truth.

episodes_data.title: Terror in Resonance Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Twelve goes off to save Lisa while Shibazaki and Hamura learn more about the Athena Plan and the Rising Peace Academy.

episodes_data.title: Terror in Resonance Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Things come to a head as Nine and Twelve go their separate ways and Shibazaki talks to Mamiya, the man behind the Athena Plan.

episodes_data.title: Terror in Resonance Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Tokyo is in a state of emergency as the country readies itself for the atomic bomb explosion. Will the mystery of Sphinx finally be solved?
